payload.title: ARCHITECTURE puts lifecycle guardrails under the runtime
payload.body: Ruled: a stale claim, not a target. Guards are canon hook cells deployed as harness hooks, plus forge's omp extension; the runtime hosts the capabilities (eventTap, design, plan, note) and no guard. Under documentation, ARCHITECTURE states what ships, so the runtime section stops placing guardrails beneath the runtime.
